'''June 2000 Phoenix tournament (10 June)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in AZ Gamer, Phoenix, AZ on 10 June 2000. It is known from Enrique Huerta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d882">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-phoenix-az-6-10-00d882/ phoenix-az-6-10-00], DeckTech (Enrique "Max of Tat" Huerta, 12 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-12-phoenix-az-6-10-00d882/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 10 June 2000
* '''Site:''' AZ Gamer, Phoenix, AZ
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
